ordinary_s4_boundary: Within each measured agent-evolver pairing, the solve/evolve protocol, evolver prompt template, trajectory window and evolver backbone are fixed while the declared target harness is updated from execution evidence. The target is skills on SWE-bench Verified and SkillsBench, and skills/prompts/memories on MCP-Atlas; the S4 regulator itself is not the adaptation target.
adaptation_loop: operational agent executes the next task batch under the current harness
execution trajectories and outputs become evidence for the A-Evolve evolver
the fixed evolver procedure proposes and applies a persistent harness update
the updated harness becomes the next agent state
later task execution measures whether the changed persistent capability is useful
metric_note: The publication defines harness-updating capability as mean pairwise evolution gain across fixed anchor agents and reports pass-rate gains in percentage points. These values are preserved as a vector of reported observations, not collapsed into a global S4 score.
comparison_scope_note: This is direct quantitative capability evidence for one canonical native S4 system across three task domains and several evolver backbones. It is not a matched cross-harness S4 comparison and does not close the primary-baseline gap.
provenance_limitation: The reported experimental runs come from the first-party harness-evolution release lineage at 96ed93ba7ee0b9519fc55c963afb47a1975eb1ae. That release lineage and canonical review ref 18ba996dac9843f2759b2cdf8a94022f58fbfeb9 diverge in Git history. The canonical review ref nevertheless contains the first-party harness-disentangling artifact and UnifiedEngine port implementing the published Exp0/Exp1 protocol. Preserve the result as first-party-reported historical evidence; it is not independently reproduced at the canonical review revision.
vsm_interpretation: The canonical assessment independently establishes A-Evolve S4=A without using benchmark gains. The published first-party protocol then directly exercises the same organizational function: external task execution evidence is interpreted by the evolver into persistent harness changes that alter later operation while the adaptation regulator remains fixed within each measured run. This therefore supplies the first canonical native direct S4 capability observation, but one system is insufficient for a matched cross-harness primary baseline.

benchmark_scope: one operator-approved run-specific locked fitness benchmark
ordinary_s4_boundary: The non-evolving kernel, approved benchmark and objective hashes, grading/evidence pipeline, scoring formulas, selection controls and lineage machinery remain outside the evolvable organism genome. Organism frameworks mutate only after grading; accepted changed genomes are activated for later epochs under the same locked fitness definition.
adaptation_loop: organisms execute under the current genome against the locked environment/fitness definition
the kernel freezes attempts and an independent Grader extracts benchmark evidence
verified scores, population evidence and elite evidence enter model-driven reflection, Tweaker and Birther adaptation paths
valid prompt/source/dependency/file genome mutations are committed after grading
the changed population is activated and later epochs execute the changed capabilities
metric_note: The first-party README reports a ten-epoch upward shift in the leading cohort. Each epoch point may represent a different top-performing agent, so these metrics describe population-level evolutionary improvement rather than one individual trajectory.
comparability_limitation: The fitness benchmark is generated from the user goal and explicitly approved and locked per run. The published proof does not expose enough run metadata to reconstruct a common model/goal/population/configuration cell with A-Evolve or another canonical S4 system. Preserve this as a heterogeneous within-system observation, not a matched cross-harness score.
vsm_interpretation: The canonical assessment independently establishes KADATH S4=A. The published proof exercises that same native path: independently graded current performance feeds model-driven mutation and reproduction of persistent organism frameworks, and changed genomes execute in later epochs while the S4 control boundary remains fixed. This supplies a second canonical native direct S4 observation but does not close the matched primary-baseline gap.
